## PopEYE — Infrared Ocular Image Dataset

Infrared ocular-image dataset supporting research on eye-position monitoring and automated ocular-image analysis.

[Institutional record (IRIS) →](https://iris.unimore.it/handle/11380/1395150)

## Responsible reuse

Each dataset record is the authoritative source for licensing terms, access conditions and citation requirements. Review it before reuse.
